meta.title: Kilometer fee, explained
meta.description: See how your Icelandic kilometer fee (kílómetragjald) estimates, extra bills and refunds add up.

startOver.title: Start over?
startOver.body: This removes your readings, rate and bills from this device. You can’t undo it.

errors.order: The latest reading must be after the previous reading.
errors.km: Enter both odometer readings in km.
errors.kmLower: The latest odometer reading is lower than the previous one. Check the numbers.
errors.rate: Enter a rate in kr per km, for example 6,95.

warnings.shifted: Your {first} and {second} amounts look swapped or shifted by a month. The bill paid at the end of a month belongs to that month; 30-day months have the smaller bill.
warnings.settlement: The {month} amount matches your extra bill. Enter the regular monthly bill here and the extra bill in step 4.
warnings.mismatch: The {month} bill works out to {perDay} km/day, but your other months work out to {typical}. Check that it’s the regular monthly bill.
warnings.bannerTitle: Some bills don’t match each other, so this breakdown may be off.

rates.car: Car or SUV up to 3.5 t
rates.customHint: Heavier vehicles pay more. Use the kr/km shown on your bill.

form.intro: Enter two odometer readings you registered on Ísland.is and the bills you paid in between. You’ll see what you actually drove, what you were billed for, and where any extra bill or refund comes from.
form.step1Help: Find them on Ísland.is under your vehicle’s odometer history.
form.noMonths: Enter both dates and the months to fill in will appear here.
form.billsHelp: The regular monthly bill for each month. Don’t include extra bills or refunds here.
form.billsHelpEarlier: Extra bills or refunds you got shortly after your previous reading belong to the period before this one. Leave them out. Only the one that came after your latest reading goes in step 4.
form.readingMonthHelp: Billed after your latest reading, so it already uses the new rate. Leave empty if it hasn’t arrived.
form.readingMonthWhy: Enter it if you have it. It makes the calculation closer to the government’s.
form.step4Help: If you already got one after the latest reading, enter it to check it against the calculation. Use a minus sign for a refund.
form.step4Which: This is the extra bill or refund that arrived after your latest reading.
form.step4WhichDate: This is the extra bill or refund that arrived after your latest reading ({date}).
form.linesSummary: Add the month lines from the bill
form.linesHelp: The extra bill lists each month with its km, for example “41,58 km”. Enter them to use the government’s exact figures instead of this app’s calculation. Use a minus sign for a refund.
form.lineLabel: Km on the extra bill for {month}
form.linesTotalOff: These lines add up to {total}, not the {entered} you entered above. Check both against the bill.

guides.readingsTitle: How to find your readings on Ísland.is
guides.readings1: Log in to <link>My vehicles on Ísland.is</link> (<is>Mínar síður → Eignir → Ökutæki</is>).
guides.readings2: Open your vehicle. Its odometer history (<is>kílómetrastaða</is>) lists every reading with its date and km.
guides.readings3: Enter the two latest readings you registered. Readings taken at repair shops, for insurance claims or in police checks don’t count toward your average, so skip those.
guides.register: No new reading yet? Register one at Register odometer reading (Skrá kílómetrastöðu) or in the Ísland.is app. Enter the km shown on your dashboard. You can register once every 30 days; a wrong entry can be fixed the same day, until midnight.
guides.billsTitle: Where to find your monthly bills
guides.bills1: In your online bank, the monthly payment is a claim from <is>Ríkissjóðsinnheimtur</is> (the state’s collection office). Other state charges can come from the same name, so check that it’s the kilometer fee (<is>kílómetragjald</is>).
guides.bills2: The bill itself is in your <link>Ísland.is mailbox</link> (<is>Pósthólf</is>). One bill covers every vehicle registered to you, so the bank amount is the total; use the amount for this vehicle from the bill.

results.inDays: in {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
results.calibrated: Uses the government’s average of {gov} km/day from your {month} bill (straight division gives {plain}).
results.footer: Calculated from your numbers using the method described on Ísland.is. Amounts not taken from your bills are estimates; the government’s own figures can differ by a few krónur. Your inputs are kept in a cookie on this device for 7 days and aren’t stored anywhere else.
results.sourceFormula: Skatturinn: how the average per day, the monthly bill and the settlement are calculated
results.sourceIsland: Ísland.is: how the kilometer fee works
results.sourcesNote: The Skatturinn pages are in Icelandic.

verdict.droveLess: Your estimates covered about {km} km more than you drove.
verdict.calcGivesExtra: This calculation gives an extra bill of {amount}.
verdict.calcGivesRefund: This calculation gives a refund of {amount}.
verdict.close: Your monthly estimates were close to what you drove, so there’s little or nothing to settle.
verdict.expectExtra: You drove about {km} km more than your estimates covered, so expect an extra bill of about {amount}.
verdict.expectRefund: Your estimates covered about {km} km more than you drove, so expect a refund of about {amount}.
verdict.linesMatch: The months below use the lines from your bill. Worked out from the readings instead, it comes to {calc}, {diff} off.
verdict.linesOff: The month lines you entered add up to {sum}, not {entered}. Check both against the bill.
verdict.matchExtra: Your extra bill of {amount} matches this within {diff}. The small difference comes from rounding.
verdict.matchRefund: Your refund of {amount} matches this within {diff}. The small difference comes from rounding.
verdict.offExtra: Your extra bill of {amount} is {diff} away from this calculation. Check that the dates and bills match your statements.
verdict.offRefund: Your refund of {amount} is {diff} away from this calculation. Check that the dates and bills match your statements.

paid.rest: That’s the whole period except {span}, which is paid in your {month} bill. The two together make the {total} above. Select {short} in the chart to see that part.

upcoming.title: Your estimated bills from now on
upcoming.help: Your new average, {perDay} km a day × {rate} kr, sets each monthly bill until you register a new reading. These are estimates, except a bill you entered yourself.
upcoming.plusExtraEst: Plus the estimated extra bill of {amount}
upcoming.tip: If you drive less from now on, registering a new reading 30 days or more later brings the difference back as a refund.

breakdown.title: Month by month
breakdown.help: Each column is a month billed by estimate before your latest reading: grey is what the estimate covered, red is km it missed and green is km it overpaid. The last column is your next bill, estimated at the new average and compared with the old one. Select a month to see the math.
breakdown.chartLabel: Km per month: paid by estimate, and the difference charged or refunded
breakdown.calcWouldBe: Worked out from the readings, this month would be {amount}.
breakdown.assumed: Your {month} bill of {amount} assumed {perDay} km a day.
breakdown.assumedPart: Your {month} bill of {amount} assumed {perDay} km a day; {days} of its {total} days belong to this period, about {portion}.
breakdown.missingWhy: The missing km are added to your extra bill.
breakdown.overpaidWhy: The overpaid km come back as a refund.
breakdown.nextAria: {month}, next bill: {amount} at the new average, {old} at the old one
breakdown.nextWhyUp: Your average went up from {old} to {new} km a day, so your {month} bill is {diff} higher than your earlier {days}-day bills.
breakdown.nextWhyDown: Your average went down from {old} to {new} km a day, so your {month} bill is {diff} lower than your earlier {days}-day bills.
breakdown.nextPeriod: {span} ({km} km, {amount} of this bill) is the end of this period; the rest is driving after it. At {rate} kr/km, every month is billed like this until your next reading.
